on invalid regex, pushes a stable error string into optionErrors and falls back to default patterns. - Uses resolveExample() to choose between nested and flat examples, defaulting when empty. - getRuleSchema() returns a JSON Schema array with: - story and req objects (properties pattern/example, additionalProperties: false). - flat pattern/example fields, and top-level additionalProperties: false. - src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts meta.schema is set to getRuleSchema(), and meta.messages includes invalidRuleConfiguration. - create() reads options via resolveOptions(context.options || []), fetches getOptionErrors(), and in Program(node) reports each configuration error: - context.report({ node, messageId: "invalidRuleConfiguration", data: { details } }); traceability.notes: The ESLint configuration story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG is fully implemented. The plugin exposes recommended and strict presets (with tests and dedicated documentation), uses ESLint v9 flat config best practices in eslint.config.js, and demonstrates seamless integration via CLI integration tests. Configuration is customizable through rule options and JSON Schema-validated structures (including storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension, scope, exportPriority, and advanced pattern options for valid-annotation-format), with invalid options handled gracefully and surfaced as clear configuration errors rather than crashes. User-facing documentation (README, ESLint 9 setup guide, API reference, config-presets) provides configuration examples for common JS, TS, mixed, and monorepo projects and includes a troubleshooting section for ESLint configuration issues. Multiple Jest tests are explicitly tagged to this story and pass successfully, covering configuration schemas, presets, and integration, so all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
